text: APPROVE: The new `JudgeAsync` is a flat sequence of early-return guards with the same check order, verdict arguments and passed-reason text as the original, so its cognitive complexity should be well under 15, and I found no behavioural change or build break in the diff. I read the diff only and did not build or run tests. One thing I couldn't confirm from the diff is that `ChangedFilesAsync`'s return type is compatible with the new `IReadOnlyList<string>` parameter on `EngineTestsStopAsync`.
